_doc: Per-concept settings (no code changes needed). rerank.colour: HSV range (H in degrees 0-360, S and V 0-255) whose pixel fraction per 14 px patch is blended into the re-rank score with rerank.colour_weight; patch_weight scales DINOv2 patch similarity. count_conf: confidence threshold for counting a result as a detected object.

change._doc: Cross-year cell similarity is the primary signal (radiometry differs between NAIP years, so colour then is only supporting evidence). new = colour now >= colour_now_min AND sim <= sim_new_max; existing = sim >= sim_existing_min OR colour then >= colour_then_keep x colour now; else unsure.

dense._disabled_doc: Uptown dense additions were ~7/50 right by eye (tall-building shadows/roof edges; data/out/shadow_Uptown_additions.png), so dense is off there

shadow._doc: A/B 2026-11-08: removes 2 of 112 (Ballantyne) and 1 of 52 (Uptown) dense objects, < 3/50 gain: kept off

dense._doc: Dense proposals are concept-colour blobs that passed the object check; at query time they only need DINOv2 similarity ≥ sim_min and to be closer to the picked examples than to the not-this negatives.

object_check._doc: SAM outlines of pools often include the deck/yard, so with outline_by_colour the final outline = SAM mask ∩ pool-cyan pixels (dilated 1 px), the connected piece at the prompt. Area range, compactness and colour fraction are checked on that refined outline.

solar_installation.experimental: eye precision ~0/12 on warehouses (roof-edge shadows); a pretrained solar verifier is pending (Phase 3)

object_check._doc: Dark roof-edge shadows share the panel colour; they are thin strips, so compactness + a minimum panel-colour area reject them.

parking_lot.experimental: under-counts large lots (Uptown 6 counted vs 407 in OSM); a lot detector / area inventory is pending (Phase 3/7)
